ideas.title: Lawn mowing and garden tidy rounds (riverside)
ideas.one_liner: Homeowners without time pay for a standing fortnightly mow and seasonal garden tidy-up.
steps: Map 20 overgrown lawns on your street
Print a one-page rate card
Door-knock with the rate card on Saturday
Book mows into a fixed fortnightly route
Offer $45 per standard mow to first five lawns
Photograph each finished lawn for the folder
Add garden tidies to regular clients
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never mow wet lawns after rain
